description: Code-behind for the StartExam page in an online examination system. Manages course selection based on user semester, initiates exam sessions for theory and MCQ tests, and handles navigation and exam access logic.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the StartExam ASP.NET page, handling course selection, navigation, and exam initiation logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load, setting up course options based on the user's semester stored in session.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Begins the selected exam (theory or MCQ) based on user selection and availability.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam from the grid, checking if already taken and starting the exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam from the grid, checking if already taken and starting the exam.
